INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT

This Independent Contractor Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into as of {{effectiveDate}} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{partyA.name}}, {{partyA.entityType}} (“Client”), and {{partyB.name}}, {{partyB.entityType}} (“Contractor”). Client and Contractor are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.”

1. Services

Contractor will perform the following services (the “Services”): {{services}}. Contractor will perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner, consistent with applicable industry standards.

2. Term

Services begin on {{startDate}} and continue until {{endDate}} unless terminated earlier under Section 8.

3. Compensation

Client will pay Contractor {{rate}}. Payment terms: {{paymentTerms}}. Contractor is responsible for all expenses unless Client approves them in writing in advance.

4. Independent Contractor Status

Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, agent or joint venturer of Client. Contractor controls the manner and means of performing the Services. Contractor is not eligible for Client employee benefits and is solely responsible for all taxes, withholdings, insurance and statutory contributions arising from the compensation paid under this Agreement.

5. Intellectual Property

All deliverables, work product, inventions and materials created by Contractor in performing the Services (the “Work Product”) are works made for hire owned by Client. To the extent any Work Product does not vest in Client by operation of law, Contractor irrevocably assigns all right, title and interest in it to Client, and will execute any documents reasonably required to perfect that assignment. Contractor retains ownership of pre-existing materials it brings to the engagement and grants Client a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use them as incorporated into the Work Product.

6. Confidentiality

Contractor will hold Client’s non-public information in confidence, use it only to perform the Services, and not disclose it to any third party. This obligation survives termination.

7. Representations

Contractor represents that it has the right to enter into this Agreement, that performing the Services will not breach any obligation to a third party, and that the Work Product will be original and will not infringe any third-party right.

8. Termination

Either Party may terminate this Agreement on {{noticeDays}} days’ written notice, or immediately for material breach that remains uncured 10 days after written notice. On termination Client will pay for Services properly performed through the termination date, and Contractor will deliver all Work Product in progress.

9. Limitation of Liability

Neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages. Each Party’s aggregate liability is limited to the total amounts paid or payable under this Agreement, except for breach of confidentiality, infringement, or wilful misconduct.

Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

Entire Agreement

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both Parties. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
